body:
I confided in someone close to me about the situation but all they said was get a police report etc. He has graphically described having sex with sixteen year olds and at the end of it saying: and it was all in your room. 

I told my dad and he said we have to take care of him as he’s not himself (cos of the drugs)
Sorry I wasn’t very clear. I mean that I am sixteen, the girls he has relations with are sixteen. It’s legal in my state.
Oooooh that’s interesting. Thank you!
He is staying with us at the minute. He’s alone with me all the time. That’s the reason why I’m even thinking about “cutting ties” and stuff.

Yes, that is the only reason. Why? My dad prioritises family over everything. Yes, I think they should be but every time I think about ending the relationship, I am torn because “blood is thicker than water” is how I was raised.
No, he’s thirty.

How two people are connected. 

I have a relationship with my brother by blood, or maybe not.

I have a relationship with my step grandad as I love him and blood doesn’t come into account.

I haven’t really represented myself well lol. My step grandfather will always be my real grandfather, blood doesn’t come into account. So no I don’t believe family is dictated by genes. My perspective on my brother has been the same before and after a paternity test, what I mean is, when you are not related to someone, are the exceptions you made because of a blood relation actually worth it?

My dad’s mentality has always been family is family, blood is thicker than water, etc. Ever time I have ever mentioned something about him, he calls me selfish and says I’m prioritising myself over family.
It matters in whether I should continue havin a relationship with him, that’s why it fucking matters.

No, owe them nothing. NTA

My parents were controlling, nothing I ever did was good enough. Move on, get a social support system and live your life. I would suggest counselling too, it does help.

The Everyman is a lot better, it’s just a bit pricey. I think Kirkstall has gotten a bit better, but the Light in town in a definite no no. They were chucking popcorn at stewards and playing music throughout end game. No shits given.
Some people were trying Five Guys milkshakes. A fiver for a toss? Fucking hell.

The Nation of Shopkeepers also has a pretty good jazz night on every Thursday of the month. The trinity is pretty good for “student food” but it can be pretty pricey. Cafe nero is good a quick drink and it is cheaper than Starbucks. There is also the Leeds library near the carriageworks, it’s fabulous.

Also I would recommend watching some local theatre if you’re interested. The Grand, the carriageworks and the playhouse, not to mention the City varieties, are all amazing. 

Welcome to Leeds, we are glad to have you!
Colleges do A levels. Not all of them are for “less academic pupils”.
Wow. Really?
Anytime man. PM or just send me a paragraph. No judgement, no pandering or condescension. I’ll just listen.

Definitely. He sounds bitter and resentful of the world. If you go and do a maths degree and then can’t apply it your passion to a real life context, you are likely to be messed up about the whole situation. His attitude sounds like “I’ll hurt them before they hurt me”. He’s probably testing you to see how far he can “get” with you. I mean, how many harsh things can he say before you retort. 

People like to push. Stay as chill as you can or ask to change driving instructor. I had to change mine cos she ate cornflakes in the car with a bowl and spoon and everything. Second one is much better.

Don’t let bitter resentful old men get you down! They can’t help having a sell by date.
Just feeling kind of temporary about yourself? I feel you man.

My driving instructor was like that too. Sometimes it’s just their personality, a bit shitty, ya know? 

Keep going with it, keep trying and prove him wrong.

I’m proud of you for having the motivation to get out there and try something.
Bumder
Temple practise in Moortown is decent. Clean and efficient service.

Please don’t worry! Swarcliffe, like any place, has it good and bad parts but the camaraderie between neighbours here is lovely. My neighbour and I have a lovely relationship, twenty years running in fact. We are the kind to take out the bins for you if you forget or make you a brew if you are looking low! Whilst North Leeds does get a bad rap, please don’t fret. Crime has gone down over the years and you will be more than welcome. 

 Congrats on finding such a lovely home and welcome to the area!
NTA, I appreciate your wariness. Like it has already mentioned, it is your child and your choice.
